doc.brief: Specifies which corner a child widget should be placed in when packed into a `GtkScrolledWindow.`
doc.md:
Specifies which corner a child widget should be placed in when packed into
a `GtkScrolledWindow.`

This is effectively the opposite of where the scroll bars are placed.

bottom_left.brief: Place the scrollbars on the top and right of the widget.
bottom_left.md:
Place the scrollbars on the top and right of the
  widget.

bottom_right.brief: Place the scrollbars on the top and left of the widget.
bottom_right.md:
Place the scrollbars on the top and left of the
  widget.

top_left.brief: Place the scrollbars on the right and bottom of the widget (default behaviour).
top_left.md:
Place the scrollbars on the right and bottom of the
  widget (default behaviour).

top_right.brief: Place the scrollbars on the left and bottom of the widget.
top_right.md:
Place the scrollbars on the left and bottom of the
  widget.
